item.title: Officials Say Temple City Woman Died By Suicide
item.description: A woman who died on New Year’s Day in Temple City took her own life, authorities said Saturday. The death occurred at about 2:25 a.m. Thursday in the 9100 block of Duffy Street, between Las Tunas Drive and Broadway, according to the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department. item.title: Palm Springs Tramway Temporarily Closed
item.description: The Palm Springs Aerial Tramway remained closed Saturday due to technical issues, tramway officials announced. The tramway suspended operations around 8 p.m. Friday when the unspecified technical issue was discovered. It was unknown when the popular attraction would reopen. More information is available at pstramway.com/.
